feeds.title: My Bait Shop Blog
feeds.description: This is the place to buy new and used old fishing lures, antique fishing lures, discontinued fishing lures, fishing collectibles and everything a good bait shop would have. Heddon, Creek Chub, Rebels, Rapalas, Pflueger, Shakespeare, South Bend, Bagley, Bomber, Helin, Lazy Ike, Norman, Storm, Smithwick and more.

feeds.title: Missile Baits Blog
feeds.description: Missile Baits is a small company dedicated to creating SERIOUS soft plastic baits to help anglers catch more fish. Our designs are straight off the top-level professional bass tour, mostly from my head. Each of our baits is unique and tested to make sure they are just right. When you pick up a bag of MISSILE BAITS soft plastics, know those baits are being fished in the world's biggest bass tournaments when only the best will cut it.

feeds.title: Pautzke Bait Blog
feeds.description: Our vision for the future is built upon our past as we strive to continue to bring innovative, industry-leading products to fruition and remain eager to continue serving you - our extended Team Pautzke family.

feeds.title: Obee Fishing Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Obee Fishing Co., a small soft plastic bait company based in New Jersey. Our handmade baits are made with the highest quality plastisol, colorant, and glitter, which gives them unmatched color, flash, and action in the water. We take pride in the fact that our baits are made with the perfect blend of plastisol to achieve the best quality and action possible. - Read about the best fishing spots and how to fish different lures and baits for different situations. How to catch big fish and find the perfect fishing spots near you.

feeds.title: Bait Cloud Blog
feeds.description: At BaitCloud we love to fish and our vision is to help every angler in every situation have a better day on the water. Our product works whether you are at the dock, on the shore, in your boat, or in your ice hut. If you can toss a BaitCloud in the water, you can use BaitCloud. We use only earth-friendly, bio-degradable ingredients, to make sure that we are gentle on the environment, and are proudly Made In America.

feeds.title: Quest Bait Blog
feeds.description: Your Mission - Our Passion. Those few words say so much because they sum up the whole philosophy of our company. If your mission is to catch more carp then our passion is to help you do it. This bait range is the culmination of the bait knowledge I've gained throughout my carp fishing career, a journey which started in the 1970's. It has truly been a long and winding road - frustrating at times, fascinating and rewarding at others.

feeds.title: Beautiful Bait blog
feeds.description: Hey everyone! I'm Paul DeRolf and this is my personal photography page. My focus is stream ecology and the amazing creatures that dwell underwater. I completed my Master's program at Ball State and looking to stay in the field studying our waters. My goal with this page is to share with you the beautiful fish and wild insects that call our freshwater ecosystems home. Each post will give details about where they live, what their role in the aquatic community is, and what they mean to the health of the water. I hope you enjoy this journey into the wonderful, underwater world.
